book.name: Naꞌ Markus
book.title: Aꞌan Alekot matoom neu Usif Jesus, natuin Naꞌ Markus in sulat

content: Usif Jesus sin ntaam neu Jerusalem, ma toob namfau pules ma naliat Ee, namnees on leꞌ kase ꞌnaek
Olas sin nhaumaak koot Jerusalem, sin ntenuk kuan nua, Betfage nok Betania, mbi ꞌnuꞌaf Oliveira in abnapan.
Naꞌko nane, Jesus sin mpao nanuk kleꞌo. Nalail, In nsonuꞌ In asium-noinaꞌ sin atoni nua nnaon nahunun.

In nak, “Hi nua ki mnao mihuun meu leꞌ kuan nae. Olas hi mtaam, lofa hi miit bikaes ‘keledai’ anaꞌ meseꞌ, leꞌ mafutuꞌ ambi nane. Tuaf es feꞌ ka nsae neu ne. Hi mnao mseif ee, ma mheel meki neem neu ii.
Mes kalu nmuiꞌ atoni nabokan ki nak, ‘Anasaaꞌ te hi mseif meik bikase nane?’ Hi mitae mak, ‘Usiꞌ he npake. Kalu npaek nalali, niꞌ hai meki nfain neem.’ ”
Nalali te, atoin nua in nane nnaon, ma sin niit bikaes aan es leꞌ mafutu mbi ume nesun leꞌ mbi lalan ninen. Ma sin nseif neki he neem neu ne.
Mes nmuiꞌ atoni ahaket mbi nane nabokan sin mnak, “Hoi! Anasaaꞌ te hi mseif atoni in bikase?”
Nalail sin natae mnak, “Hai Usiꞌ nloem he npaek je. Kalu npaek nalali, niꞌ hai meki nfain neem.” Ma atoni leꞌ nane kin, sin nafetin he nheel neik bikase nane.
Sin nheel neki nnao neu Jesus. Nalali te, sin napeinit bikaes aneik sin tainusat. Oke te, Jesus ansaeꞌ.
Olas sin he ntaam neu koot in nanan, nmuiꞌ atoni namfau sin nait sin bael tainusat, ma nok sin beit anaꞌ, ma naꞌbene neu lalan. Ma bian nnaon nꞌoten peet noꞌo
mbi lalan ninen, he sin nabeen neu lalan tnanan. Nane nmoꞌe takaf nak sin nseun Usif Jesus nok neek pules. On leꞌ sin biasa nseun kase ꞌnaek.
Ma nmuiꞌ atoni bian nnaon nahunun neu Jesus In matan, ma nmuiꞌ atuinas naꞌko In kotin. Ma sin naꞌbaaꞌ mnak,

content.text: Uisneno nateut atoni leꞌ neem neik Usiꞌ In kanan,
Fun Uisneno he nahake nfain Usif David in plenat!
Fun Uisneno In ntook naplenat mbi neno tunan in aꞌlatan!”

content: Olas sin ntenuk koot in nanan, Jesus sin ntaam neu Uisneno In Uim Onen Uuf in kintal. Ma Jesus nail lek-leok nateef bale nane. Mes, fun neem bi nmaeb je, sin nnaon nfanin mbi kuan Betania.
Usif Jesus nak haub es he nkais nafua ntein
Mbi nok-nok anaꞌ, sin nnaon mpoin naꞌko Betania, he nnaon nfain neu koot Jerusalem. Mes mbi lalan tnanan, Jesus namnaah.
In napeen niit hau uuf es in anmoni mbi lalan ninen. Atoni biasa neuk in fuan.
Ma Jesus nnao nhaumaak hau uuf nane ma he nail nafua, ka aiꞌ kah. Mes olas In ntee haub nane in uun, In ka niit naan fa hau fua es. Fun feꞌ ka ntee in toon he nafuaꞌ. In fa niit sa natuna.
Ma Jesus naꞌuab neu haub nane mnak, “Fun ho ka mufua fa he Au ꞌeuk, jadi mulai naꞌko ii, ho lof ka mufua mtein fa neu atoni bian antein!” In asium-noinaꞌ sin nneen In naꞌuab maꞌfenaꞌ on nane.
Usif Jesus ntaam mbi Uim Onen Uuf. Nalali te, In naleꞌun pasaꞌ mbi nane

Oke te, sin nnaon piut, tal antee Jerusalem, ma Jesus ntaam antein mbi Uisneno In Uim Onen Uuf. Mbi Uim Onen nane in kintal, toob nmoeꞌ nfain Uim Onen nane on pasaꞌ he sin naꞌsaꞌun kool pani leꞌ biasa atoni neik nmoeꞌ neu onen naꞌtuluꞌ. Nail on nane te, Jesus nnao nliuꞌ napoin sin. In isuꞌ-baiꞌ meij-meij leꞌ sin npaken he matukal neik loit. Ma In ntepon naleꞌun bangku-bangku leꞌ sin npaken he naꞌsaꞌu kolo nane.
In nakain toob ok-okeꞌ he ka nabeiꞌ neik sin baleꞌ nnaon natuin nuk Uim Onen in kintal nane in nanan.

Ma In naꞌnoinaꞌ sin mnak, “Hi mihiin milail saaꞌ es leꞌ Uisneno In mafefaꞌ leꞌ nluul nani nak, ‘Au ufenaꞌ Au ume ije, henati atoni naꞌko pah-pah he neman nꞌonen mbi ii.’ Mes hi mmoeꞌ ume ii nfain on atoin abakat in bale tolaꞌ!”
Olas ꞌnakaf-aꞌnakaf akama ma kulu akama sin nnenan Jesus nmoeꞌ on nane, sin natooꞌ Ne. Oke te, sin namin lalan he naꞌmaet Ee. Mes sin namtaun amsat, fun nmuiꞌ toob namfau nloem he nnenan In aꞌnoinaꞌ.
Olas mbi neon nmabeꞌ, Jesus sin mpoin naꞌko koot Jerusalem, nfain he ntupan mbi kuan Betania.
Kalu hit maneꞌo-maneꞌo tpalsai neu Uisneno, In he nfee kit saaꞌ leꞌ hit ttoti

Mbi nok-nok anaꞌ, sin nnaon nfanin onuk Jerusalem. Mbi lalan in tnanan, sin nneis natuin haub leꞌ afi Jesus nak ee. In asium-noinaꞌ sin namkakan, fun natuin haub nane nmeto nmaet tal antee in aꞌbaꞌan. Ma Pedru namnau niit Jesus In molok leꞌ afi nane. Nalail in natoon am nak, “Amaꞌ! Mail miit! Haub nane leꞌ afi Ama nleꞌat-tebaꞌ, nmate!”
Ma Jesus natae mnak, “Namneo! Ile lamu hi mpalsai neu Uisneno on nane.

Kalu maneꞌo-maneꞌo hi mpalsai, hi nabeiꞌ mleul ꞌnuꞌaf es he naskout on tasi. Ma Uisneno msat naskotub ꞌnuꞌaf nane, ile lamu hi neek palsait nane kaisa stena-stena! Mes hi musti mpalsai maneꞌo-maneꞌo neu Uisneno.
Kais mipnikan, he! Ile lamu hi mpalsai maneꞌo-maneꞌo mak Uisneno nabeiꞌ anfee saaꞌ leꞌ hi mtoit, In lofa nmoeꞌ neu ki!
Mes kalu nmuiꞌ atoni nꞌonen, ma in nekan nanan ka nmanleko fa nok atoni bian, in musti manleko nok atoni nane feꞌ. On nane, niꞌ hi Ama mbi neno tunan nnoes ki hi sanat ma penu.
[Kalu hi mneek asꞌunu, ma ka mloem mkaos fa atoni bian sin sanat, hi Ama mbi neno tunan msat ka nloem fa he napnikan hi sanat ma penu sin.]
Sin masuiꞌlin neu Usif Jesus In hak
Oke te, sin nnaon piut. Ntenuk Jerusalem, sin ntaman ntenin mbinuk Uisneno In Uim Onen Uuf. Olas sin ntaman ntenuk kintal naan, ꞌnakaf-aꞌnakaf akama ma kulu akama sin neman,
he maksuilꞌin nok Jesus mnak, “Afi, sikau es anleul ko, he ho oum mmoeꞌ humaꞌ-humaꞌ mbi ii? Sikau es anfee ko hak!?”
Mes Jesus nahiin sin namin lalan he namofu. Oke te, In natae nak, “Au he ꞌtoti ꞌfain ki msat. Hi mitae Kau feꞌ, he niꞌ Au utae ki.
Au he ꞌtoit ki, on ii: hi ok-okeꞌ leꞌ ii mihiin naꞌ Joao, Aslain Atoni nane, aiꞌ? Sikau es anlelu ee he nnao naslain atoni? Uisneno ka, aiꞌ mansian?”

Nalali te, sin natenab nuu-neman, ma ntolan naketi lasi mnak, “Akee! Hit he tapeni, ee! Kalu hit tatae mtak, ‘Uisneno es anlelu,’ lofa in natae mnak, ‘Kalu on naan, anasaaꞌ te hi ka mpalsai fa neu naiꞌ Joao?!’
Mes hit msat lof ka tak fa, tak, ‘Mansian es anlelu.’ Fun atoin in ok-okeꞌ lof namaunun. Fun sin npalsai nak, naꞌ Joao nane, Uisneno in mafefa kninuꞌ.”
Nalail sin natae mnak, “Hai ka mihiin ee fa!” Ma Jesus natae nfani mnak, “Kalu on naan, Au msat ka utoon ki fa, ꞌak sikau es anleul Kau.”

footnotes.text: Sin nakanab ‘Oliveira’ mbi ꞌnuꞌaf nane, fun mbi nae nmuiꞌ lele ma nok haub oliveira, he namees in minaꞌ naꞌko haub nane in fuan. ꞌNuꞌaf Oliveira nane, in naꞌloꞌon kilo meseꞌ naꞌko koot Jerusalem.
Sula Kninoꞌ Naiꞌ Markus lulat un-unuꞌ nak ‘tlaef-tlaef’. Mes hit tahine mbi Naiꞌ Joao elaꞌ 12:13 nak nane peet noꞌo.
‘Hosana’ neik sin laes Aram nak, ‘in nsoi nafetin kai!’ Olas Usif Jesus fe ꞌ nmoin, sin biasa npaek uab nane he mpules ma nalaitan Uisneno.

Sula ninoꞌ laes Gregu (Yunani) nteke nak, hau nane ‘sukē’. Laes Portu nteke nak, ‘figeiro’. Laes Indonesia nteke nak ‘ara’. Mbi Indonesia panin neon-saet ma nok mbi Timor Lorosae, atoni ka neku fa hau ‘ara’ in fuan nane. Mbi Sula Kninoꞌ ka namnees fa nok hit haub ‘ara’ mbi hit Pah Meto ii.
Mbi lasi Gregu (Yunani) un-unuꞌ, ka nmuiꞌ fa lulat mbi elaꞌ 26 ii.
